outcomes.statement: communicates ideas, concepts and solutions for engineering practice
analyses relationships between engineering design, production and sustainability
investigates and evaluates engineering systems and solutions
develops and applies technical graphics in engineering contexts
explains engineering practices and the influence of technologies used in engineering industries
applies mechanical analysis and practical testing to investigate engineering concepts
applies risk management and safe work practices in engineering contexts
selects and applies materials for engineering projects
